item.title: Cornell taps former acting U.S. attorney general for rape case review
item.description: Cornell University has named Sally Yates, a former acting U.S. attorney general and career federal prosecutor, to lead an independent review.

item.title: 2026 National Book Awards finalists announced
item.description: Three-time finalist Edwidge Danticat and debut novelist Morgan Thomas are among the fiction nominees. Nonfiction works cover various topics.

item.title: Vietnam police arrest 12 in cat meat snatching ring
item.description: Investigators say the group recruited motorcyclists to roam neighborhoods at night, trapping up to 10 cats per night, state media reported.

item.title: Nationwide Protests in India Over Voter List Changes
item.description: The campaign is partly led by India's "Cockroach" youth movement, which previously pushed the education minister to resign.
